data.summary: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator with 4+ years of hands-on experience administering and developing on the Now Platform across ITSM, CSM, and SPM (formerly ITBM). Strong administration background — user/group/role management, update sets, ACLs, clones, upgrades, and platform governance — complemented by development skills in Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Script Includes, Flow Designer, and Service Portal widgets. Experienced in configuring Agile 2.0/SAFe, Demand, Project and Resource Management in SPM, and building Case, Account, and Entitlement workflows in CSM. Known for being the reliable platform owner who keeps instances healthy, delivers clean configurations, and partners closely with senior developers and architects on larger builds.

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Experienced in configuring Agile 2.0/SAFe, Demand, Project and Resource Management in SPM, and building Case, Account, and Entitlement workflows in CSM. raw_sections.skills:
TECHNICAL SKILLS
ServiceNow Administration
User/Group/Role management, ACLs, Data Policies, Update Sets, Clone management, Instance upgrades, System properties, LDAP/SSO (SAML) setup, Email configuration, Platform governance & health monitoring
ITSM
Incident, Problem, Change (Standard/Normal/Emergency), Request, Knowledge (KCS), CMDB foundations, SLA/OLA definitions, Assignment rules, Notifications, Service Catalog, Record Producers
CSM
Case Management, Accounts & Contacts, Contracts & Entitlements, Agent Workspace, Communities basics, Customer Service Portal, Major Issue Management, Omnichannel setup, Advanced Work Assignment (AWA)
SPM (ITBM)
Demand Management, Project & Portfolio Management, Resource Management, Agile 2.0 / SAFe, Scrum boards, Test Management, Innovation Management, Financial Planning basics
Development
Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, Script Includes, Scheduled Jobs, Flow Designer, Workflow Editor, Service Portal widgets, Record Producers, basic scoped app configuration
Integrations (Working Knowledge)
REST/SOAP consumer configuration, IntegrationHub spokes (pre-built), MID Server setup & monitoring, Inbound/Outbound email actions, basic Scripted REST APIs under senior guidance
Languages & Tech
JavaScript (Glide API), HTML5, CSS3, basic AngularJS (Service Portal), Jelly, XML, JSON, SQL basics
Tools & Practices
ATF (Automated Test Framework), Performance Analytics, Reports & Dashboards, HI Portal, ServiceNow Studio, JIRA, Confluence, Agile/Scrum, ITIL v4
Upgrades Handled
Paris, Quebec, Rome, San Diego, Tokyo, Utah, Vancouver, Washington DC, Xanadu,Zurich.
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Deputy Manager [HCL Technologies Ltd.] — [Bangalore, India]
[March - 2022] – Present
Platform owner for a ServiceNow instance supporting 10,000+ internal users and external customers across ITSM, CSM, and SPM. Combine day-to-day administration with junior developer contributions on enhancement backlog items.
Own end-to-end platform administration — user/role management, ACL reviews, update set promotion across Dev → Test → UAT → Prod, and quarterly clone management with preserver data rules.
Led three successful ServiceNow version upgrades (Tokyo → Utah → Vancouver → Washington DC) with zero post-go-live Sev-1 incidents; drove skipped-record analysis, ATF regression runs (150+ tests), and UAT coordination.
Worked on CAD-focused ServiceNow development and custom application enhancements • Configured and maintain ITSM modules — Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge — including 40+ SLA/OLA definitions, assignment rules, and notifications aligned to ITIL v4.
Administer CSM implementation supporting 20+ B2B customer accounts — configured cases, accounts/contacts, contracts & entitlements, Advanced Work Assignment, and the Customer Service Portal; reduced case routing errors by ~50%.
Manage SPM footprint: Demand intake, Project & Portfolio Management, Resource workbench, and Agile 2.0 boards for 12 product squads; built custom demand assessment workflow in Flow Designer.
Developed and maintained Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Script Includes, and Flow Designer flows for medium-complexity enhancements (under architect review).
Built 15+ Service Portal Record Producers and catalog items; authored 5 custom Service Portal widgets (HTML/CSS/AngularJS) for internal request experiences.
Set up and maintain MID Servers, LDAP integration, SAML SSO, and 10+ REST/SOAP integrations with ticketing, monitoring, and HR systems.
Run platform governance: weekly update-set review, ACL hygiene reports, slow-transaction dashboards, scheduled job health, and monthly instance health reviews with the architect.
Mentor 2 junior admins; authored internal runbooks for clone, upgrade, and incident response procedures. • Administered ServiceNow instances for 3 simultaneous clients — handled access management, update sets, clones, and production support per SLA.
Delivered ITSM configurations for a mid-size bank: Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge, CMDB foundation, and SLA framework — go-live in 12 weeks.
Implemented foundational CSM for a manufacturing client: Accounts, Contacts, Cases, and email-to-case channel; configured Customer Service Portal with branded theme.
Built 20+ Flow Designer flows and Business Rules for medium-complexity enhancements; partnered with senior developers on larger scripted REST integrations.
Handled L2/L3 production support — resolved 500+ tickets within SLA; performed RCA for recurring issues and proposed permanent fixes.
Executed two annual ServiceNow upgrades (Rome → San Diego → Tokyo) including clone-back, skipped- record review, and regression testing.
Administered Dev / Test / UAT / Prod instances — user management, update sets, ACLs, and scheduled job monitoring.
Configured Incident, Problem, and Change modules per ITIL best practices; built assignment rules, SLA definitions, and email notifications.
Developed first Service Portal widgets and Record Producers to modernize intake for IT and facilities requests.
Built Performance Analytics dashboards and scheduled reports for operations leadership, replacing manual Excel reporting.
Supported yearly ServiceNow upgrades — executed clone-back, skipped-record analysis, and regression testing under senior guidance.
raw_sections.projects:
KEY PROJECTS
CSM Rollout for B2B Customer Base — Administered and configured the full CSM module — Accounts, Contacts, Cases, Contracts & Entitlements, Agent Workspace, Advanced Work Assignment, and the Customer Service Portal. Partnered with senior developer on custom integrations; owned all configuration, UAT, and go-live support.
SPM / PPM Modernization — Rolled out Demand, Project, Resource, and Agile 2.0 modules for 12 product squads. Built custom demand scoring workflow in Flow Designer; configured resource workbench and capacity planning for a 200-person engineering org.
Platform Governance & Upgrade Playbook — Authored a reusable upgrade playbook (pre-checks, skipped records, ATF runs, UAT, cut-over) now used as the standard across three instances. Reduced upgrade delivery time by ~30% and eliminated post-upgrade Sev-1s for the last 3 cycles.
